description: The bundled offline till (DigitGlance Trade, window `till`, the app's own pages only: no `remote` section). Device HTTP goes through the HTTP plugin, scoped to the production API only, because the API's CORS does not list the Tauri origins. The save dialog picks where export_pending writes the unsent sales. open_backoffice opens the web back office in its own `backoffice` window, which has no IPC beyond core.
